Notices are accepted by Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, Standing Counsel who appears for respondent nos.1 & 2 and Ms. Malvika Kapila Kalra, Advocate who appears for Delhi Development Authority (DDA).
8. Issue notice to the remaining respondent, returnable on 22nd September 2025.
